SAC - Student Affairs Committee 
Objective:  
The primary objective of the SAC (Student Affairs Committee) is to encourage students to 
actively participate in the planning and execution of various student clubs and take ownership 
of organizing various activities, competitions, and other events on campus. The structure of 
SAC is as shown below. 
Composition: 
Faculty Advisory Committee: 
Faculty Advisory Committee to enhance student activities and the overall campus experience. The 
committee's primary goal is to provide insights, recommendations, and guidance to the SAC, ensuring 
that student activities align with the diverse needs and preferences of the student body.

The individuals selected for the SAC on campus were chosen for their dedication, enthusiasm, and 
ability to enhance student activities. The Faculty Committee is excited about the positive impact on 
student activities. 
Council wise student body: 
A Student Council is a group of students who plan and execute events and activities at the college &  
department level in technical, cultural, sports, and other areas in a collaborative way along with the 
support of the faculty. Student councils are formed at the beginning of the academic year to plan the 
efficient operation of student clubs and other areas of focus.  
Presidential Council:  
It is a student leadership body that works closely with the President of the councils to support decision-
making, coordination, and planning of student -related activities. It serves as a bridge between the 
student community and the administration, helping to communicate ideas, address concerns, and 
implement initiatives that enhance campus life.

Cultural Clubs Council: The Cultural clubs Council is responsible for initiatives for student clubs such 
as DANCE CLUB, MUSIC CLUB, LITERARY AND APPRECIATION CLUB, ARTS & CRAFTS CLUB. Additionally, 
the council supports SVCE campus club development workshops and chances to build stronger clubs. 
The priority of the council is to support all clubs as they reach their full potential.

NSS Council: The NSS Council is an integral part of the National Service Scheme under the Ministry of 
Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India. It encourages students to participate in social service 
activities with the motto “Not Me But You, ” promoting selflessne ss and social responsibility. The 
council organizes various programs such as blood donation camps, tree plantation drives, cleanliness 
campaigns, and health awareness programs. Through these activities, students develop leadership 
qualities, teamwork, and a sense of commitment towards society. The NSS Council also aims to 
promote national integration, rural development, and environmental protection.
